title: Booking Calendar Template
summary: Portfolio demo: week-based slot picker with confirmation flow; demo payment step skipped — booking workflow template.
problem: Service businesses need a clear booking UI before connecting calendars, payments, and reminders — but AI-generated demos often skip the scheduling UX entirely.
solution: Self-built portfolio demo (apps/booking-calendar). Pick a week, choose an available slot, confirm details, and see a success state; payment is intentionally skipped so the focus stays on the scheduling workflow. Reusable starting point for Cal.com-style integrations or custom backends.

zh.title: 预约日历模板
zh.summary: 作品集演示：按周选时段 + 确认流程；演示中跳过支付步骤，聚焦预约工作流。
zh.problem: 服务业在接日历、支付和提醒之前，需要先有一套清晰的预约界面，而很多 AI 生成 demo 往往缺少排期体验。
zh.solution: 自建作品集演示（apps/booking-calendar）。选择一周、挑选可用时段、确认信息并看到成功页；支付步骤故意跳过，突出排期流程本身。可作为接 Cal.com 类服务或自建后端的起点。
